hypotheses.R0_third_panel_is_fresh: The evaluation panel is disjoint from both original residual-atlas panels.
hypotheses.R1_recursive_interactions_improve_write_: Adding the frozen coarse current-class by next-class interaction vocabulary improves third-panel write R2 by at least 0.03 in at least two layers.
hypotheses.R2_recursive_features_explain_prior_resi: At least three of the eight previously selected residual axes have AUROC at least 0.90 for one frozen coarse interaction on the third panel.
hypotheses.R3_residual_geometry_survives_recursive_: After adding coarse interactions, rank-16 residual subspace overlap is at least 0.70 in at least three layers.
hypotheses.R4_recursive_expansion_reduces_late_resi: The top-five residual eigenvalue share at L17 falls by at least 0.10 relative to the primitive declared ontology.
hypotheses.R5_late_compact_residual_code_survives: Extended-feature prediction plus a rank-16 residual subspace reaches at least 0.95 total write R2 at L17 on the third panel.
hypotheses.R6_stable_unexplained_axes_remain: At least two extended-residual axes are stable at cosine 0.75 but have maximum coarse-interaction AUROC below 0.75.
